Currently, aroma.affymetrix does not implement nor provide a wrapper
to existing genotype calling methods. If you are using R, 'oligo'
should be your best shot (with model CRLMM), but the on the other hand
I don't know how much work you have to do in order to setup the
annotation files/databases for your custom chip types. An alternative
could be to use one of Affymetrix' tools for running their BRLMM.

[Aroma.affymetrix used to provide a trial version of genotype calling
by interfacing to oligo/CRLMM or Affy/BRLMM. However, I had a hard
time to catch up with the updates of these tools so I decided to
discontinue its support. I believe it would be great to provide a
transparent interface to oligo from inside aroma.affymetrix, so if
someone is "out there" is thinking about this, and no a little bit of
the aroma.affymetrix/oligo structure, I am happy to provide guidance
on how to it.]

Cheers

Henrik
